sections.heading: Glossary term: Satellite
sections.body: A satellite is an object that orbits a planet, dwarf planet, or a smaller body such as an asteroid. These can be artificial satellites launched by humans or natural satellites, normally known as moons. The Earth has one natural satellite, the Moon, and many artificial satellites orbiting it. The term satellite galaxy is also sometimes used to refer to one galaxy that orbits another galaxy.

sections.source_html:
Glossary term: Satellite

Description: A satellite is an object that orbits a planet, dwarf planet, or a smaller body such as an asteroid. These can be artificial satellites launched by humans or natural satellites, normally known as moons. The Earth has one natural satellite, the Moon, and many artificial satellites orbiting it.

The term satellite galaxy is also sometimes used to refer to one galaxy that orbits another galaxy.

Related Terms:

  • Asteroid
  • Moons
  • Planet
  • Artificial Satellite


See this term in other languages

Term and definition status: This term and its definition have been approved by a research astronomer and a teacher

The OAE Multilingual Glossary is a project of the IAU Office of Astronomy for Education (OAE) in collaboration with the IAU Office of Astronomy Outreach (OAO). The terms and definitions were chosen, written and reviewed by a collective effort from the OAE, the OAE Centers and Nodes, the OAE National Astronomy Education Coordinators (NAECs) and other volunteers. You can find a full list of credits here. All glossary terms and their definitions are released under a Creative Commons CC BY-4.0 license and should be credited to "IAU OAE".

If you notice a factual error in this glossary definition then please get in touch.
sections.body_ru: Спутник — это объект, который обращается вокруг планеты, карликовой планеты или меньшего тела, такого как астероид. Это могут быть искусственные спутники, запущенные людьми, или естественные спутники, обычно называемые лунами. Земля имеет один естественный спутник, Луну, и множество искусственных спутников, обращающихся вокруг неё. Термин «галактика-спутник» также иногда используется для обозначения одной галактики, которая обращается вокруг другой галактики.
